base_member_text: [L19] (LOW/input truncation) Command-line arguments are read into a fixed 100-character buffer without checking truncation status, so a long option can be silently shortened before parsing.
audit_member_text: [L9,L19] (LOW/command-line truncation) Command arguments are read into a fixed 100-character buffer without length or status handling, so longer arguments are silently truncated.

[L16-L44] (LOW/argument-validation gap) Unknown command-line options are silently ignored, and multiple informational options are all processed rather than terminating after the first recognized request.
